==Description==
The '''Bones''' was an enemy that first appeared on Wave 5 of the [[Rotfield]] map. It had higher health than the [[Undead (Solar Eclipse)|Undead]] and [[Mummy (Solar Eclipse)|Mummy]], but walked slightly slower than the [[Mummy (Solar Eclipse)|Mummy]].

==Appearance==
The '''Bones''' was entirely made out of marble white parts that resembled a skeleton. It did not have a full torso, but instead had the bone cage for it. Its head was slightly smaller than usual and had two large black eyes.

==Strategy==
*The '''Bones''' are quite easy to defeat, as they have a fairly low health and speed. 
**Starter towers like the [[Scout]] or [[Soldier]] should be sufficient to defeat them.
*Cheap towers with high DPS such as the [[Crook Boss]], [[Minigunner]], and [[Gladiator]] are very useful against this.
**Additionally, you can use [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] to boost these towers' firerate and range, respectively.
**Do note that the low cash supply in [[Rotfield]] may limit the potential of these towers.
*The [[Toxic Gunner]] and [[Freezer]], among other slowing towers, are useful for slowing this down, giving your towers more time to defeat it.
*The [[Ace Pilot]]'s bombs and bullets do a good job at eliminating this enemy, as they spawn in hordes.
